reviews.title: Ads ruin a middling app
reviews.text:
The app is fine. It’s an obvious knock off of other more popular apps with similar naming and color scheme, but it still connected to my tv. The constant ads are insufferable, and it wants to track your activity across your phone making the app completely unusable. Once I learned I could connect another remote app for free and without ads I promptly switched and never looked back. 

I cannot believe I wasted my time with such a consumer UNFRIENDLY app and ask all those considering to download it to reconsider another option to save yourself the time of day. I have never left an app review before, but I am happy to start with this app giving it the lowest possible rating and sincerely wishing for its creators and peddlers to be investigated by every time wasting and nickel-&-diming gov’t agency that exists because that is the general experience of using this unbearable app. 

1/10 — it works but at the expense of one the worst user experiences I have ever encountered. May it rot until time immemorial.
